author: Prakash oli
review_text: “My overall experience with eSewa has been very positive. The platform offers a wide range of services, including bill payments, money transfers, and mobile top-ups, all of which are easy to complete. The app is well-designed and functions smoothly without lag. I also appreciate the security features and the prompt transaction confirmations. In terms of convenience and reliability, eSewa is one of the best digital wallets available. I would highly recommend it to others.”
